messages:
alyssa: incident-bot just paged P1: spike in 502/504s from ingress-l7 in eu-west-1. lots of failed POSTs to /v1/generate. observed starting ~14:21 UTC

incident-bot: Pager | P1 | service: ingress-l7 | symptom: 502/504 rate > 8% across region eu-west-1 | metric: 5xx_rate

sam: ack, oncall. pulling grafana now. can someone confirm if there's a recent deploy?

deploy-bot: Deploy finished by jenna at 2026-03-15T14:18:43Z - rollout id 8a3f. No rollback.

mohit: saw that deploy. there was an Envoy config tweak to connection_pool settings in the rollout.

jenna: I rolled a small envoy flag change (reduce conn idle) to address slow upstreams. didn't hit canary alerts. rolling back now.

sam: looking at ingress logs: upstream reset errors and 502 from our gateway, not 5xx from model hosts. stack shows upstream connection failure: "upstream reset before response" in Envoy

kai: metric snapshot:
- 5xx rate: 12% (baseline <0.5%)
- p50 latency: 210ms -> 380ms
- error path: /v1/generate (POST)

support-lead: Support queue getting some customer reports from EU customers in production. logging CSAT risk. ETA for mitigation?

alyssa: immediate mitigation steps: 1) pause/config rollback (jenna) 2) route traffic to legacy pool (sam) 3) adjust idle timeouts on LB to 30s (mohit) 4) bump ingress replicas (kai) 5) enable per-route fallback to dedicated pool (jenna)

jenna: rollback initiated: rollback started -> finish expected in ~60s :hourglass_flowing_sand: 

sam: routing ~30% -> legacy pool via feature flag `router.fallback` (cmd):
```
curl -X POST https://admin.internal/route/override -d '{"route":"/v1/*","percent":"30","target":"legacy-pool-eu"}'
```

mohit: NLB timeout change applied to 30s for eu-west-1. will propagate in ~20s.

kai: scaling ingress replicas +2. `kubectl scale deploy ingress --replicas=8 -n prod`

incident-bot: Rollback completed for rollout 8a3f by jenna at 14:22:05Z

sam: monitoring... 5xx rate down to 3.8% and dropping. latency stabilizing.

support-lead: sending temporary customer advisory: "We are aware of increased failures in EU for generation endpoints; mitigations in progress." TL;DR

alyssa: handoff to morning shift in 30m for follow-up and root cause. postmortem ticket being created. primary suspect: conn pool changes in Envoy tweak; follow-ups: run synthetic load to replicate, additional canary checks, improve deploy rollback automation.

mohit: note: we saw connection resets to upstream IPs with high retransmits. collect tcpdump on failing nodes: `tcpdump -i eth0 port 443 -w /tmp/ingress-fail.pcap`

jenna: adding to postmortem ticket: rollout id 8a3f, config diff, canary gaps

sam: last check: 5xx = 0.6% now. closing pager but keeping incident channel open for 1h. :white_check_mark:

kai: leaving follow-up tasks in #incidents-triage board. tagging @product-ops for customer comms.

alyssa: thanks all — signal looks nominal. will post incident timeline and severity classification in the ticket.
